target: Freeze registry-backed MCP identity, sharing, lease, ownership, event namespace, and runner materialization contracts without runtime effect.
invariants: This packet is L2 contract work only and must produce no service cutover, runtime mutation, container mutation, database mutation, runner-global configuration mutation, or migration.
The repo_binding.project_id value `dopemux-mvp` is the current Task Packet governance label only; it is not the future canonical MCP registry project_id.
Canonical MCP project identity is registry-issued and stable; Git common-dir, path, CWD, port, container, environment, MCP connection/session state, and clientInfo remain locators or evidence only.
Unknown or conflicting canonical identity cannot authorize mutable routing.
The only sharing classes are HOST_SINGLETON, PROJECT_SCOPED, WORKTREE_SCOPED, and RETIRED.
ConPort Wave 2 remains unauthorized; this packet may freeze its gate but may not implement or authorize it.
dope-memory V1 target is PROJECT_SCOPED; host-singleton remains deferred.
Serena V1 remains WORKTREE_SCOPED; host-singleton remains deferred.
redis-events project isolation must precede dope-memory project consolidation.
Normal runner launch or worktree switching must not rewrite shared global runner configuration.
MCP protocol or SDK session identity must never substitute for registry-backed tenancy.
Every service topology flip remains blocked by its exact flip gate and zero-tolerance falsification.
Current runtime files that implement v1 identity, catalog, leases, launch, or services are forbidden in this packet and remain P1-or-later work.

pr.title: feat(mcp): freeze multiproject identity and sharing contracts
pr.body:
## Summary
- publish the ratified R2 P0 identity/sharing contract as design-only schemas and references
- preserve current v1 runtime unchanged
- add fail-closed negative contract tests

## Boundaries
- no service cutover or runtime mutation
- no ConPort Wave 2
- no global runner config rewrite
- no merge or activation authority

## Audit
- one final independent L2 audit on the frozen substantive content head

steps.task: Bind current repository state, G0 architecture authority, exact allowlist, open-PR overlap, and isolated-worktree execution before any edit.
requirements: Reharvest current main; authoring observation is 04be55535d1582c304cf31a02923fb9c521ab547.
Read the current root AGENTS.md and any closer scoped AGENTS.md before edits.
Use a new isolated worktree; do not reuse the detached R0 checkout or any foreign worktree.
Reharvest open PR exact-path overlap, including PR #1297 and MCP SDK compatibility PR #1271 if still open.
Stop if current main materially changes any allowed P0 path or governing identity/authority contract.
validation: Current main, branch, worktree, clean-state, and overlap evidence are recorded before mutation.
No forbidden runtime/service file is added to the allowlist.

steps.task: Publish the P0 ADR, exact R2 service topology and falsification references, packet bytes, plan, and registry index entry without changing current runtime.
requirements: R2 source package must remain bound to SHA-256 fa78556b2d51cd3b22d8c42ff36bd6c3964172ddee6a75662cde61db438e3996.
Service topology copy must hash to df8636983e23c273eeb8eb517ea4019653b4c6bcb50cae344cde2e847214d4c2.
Falsification contract copy must hash to 84b6e68f929e5b3f3ad37e9c2843755cc38a3a119fc87b5af057505d8ed83bcb.
ADR must preserve all ten operator binding conditions.
validation: Exact source hashes match the frozen R2 members.
Current v1 catalog, identity implementation, lease implementation, service code, compose, and runner-global configs are unchanged.

steps.task: Add a strict resolved-execution-identity design schema that makes registry identity authoritative and aliases evidence-only.
requirements: VERIFIED identity requires project_id, workspace_id, instance_id, registry_generation, actor_id, and client_id.
CONFLICTING or UNKNOWN identity forces mutable_routing_allowed=false.
Path/CWD/env/clientInfo/session/port/container facts may appear only in evidence/alias fields.
validation: Missing IDs, stale/conflicting registry generation, and evidence-only identity override fixtures fail closed.

steps.task: Add design-only service-topology and fleet-catalog-v2 schemas while preserving the live v1 catalog and loader.
requirements: fleet-catalog-v2 version is exactly 2.
Legacy scope/state_scope/multi_project_singleton fields are rejected by the v2 schema.
Every v2 server declares sharing_class, target_class, identity_scope, state_authority, mutation_class, endpoint_policy, probe, idle_policy, and flip_gate.
R2 service topology validates as exactly 26 rows over the four allowed sharing classes.
commands: uv run --extra test pytest -q tests/arch/test_mcp_multiproject_contracts.py -k 'topology or catalog_v2'
validation: Legacy v1-only sharing fields and unauthorized multi_project_singleton fail.
Live mcp_catalog.yaml remains version 1 and byte-unmodified by this packet.

steps.task: Add design-only endpoint lease and ownership-evidence schemas that refuse foreign or ambiguous mutation.
requirements: PROJECT_SCOPED leases require project_id; WORKTREE_SCOPED leases require project_id and instance_id.
RETIRED services cannot own leases.
Lease endpoint authority does not create domain authority.
mutation_eligible=true is valid only for OWNED classification with registry, exact lease, service-family probe, and storage/mount corroboration.
commands: uv run --extra test pytest -q tests/arch/test_mcp_multiproject_contracts.py -k 'lease or ownership'
validation: Stale, foreign, ambiguous, and label-only ownership fixtures cannot authorize mutation.
No lease fixture derives ownership from a port formula or path hash.

steps.task: Add design-only runner materialization receipt and project event-envelope schemas.
requirements: Runner receipt authority is PROVENANCE_ONLY.
shared_global_config_mutated is always false.
Strict runner mode cannot claim success with inherited_surface_status UNKNOWN.
Every project event has explicit project_id, workspace_id, instance_id, registry_generation, source service, event identity, and payload digest.
The event contract does not authorize Redis migration or canonical promotion.
commands: uv run --extra test pytest -q tests/arch/test_mcp_multiproject_contracts.py -k 'materialization or event'
validation: Global rewrite, missing identity, and unscoped event fixtures are rejected.
The event schema remains transport evidence, not canonical-domain authority.

steps.task: Add cross-contract static/adversarial tests for authority, exact hashes, P5-before-P4 ordering, and P0 no-runtime-effect.
requirements: Tests assert the ten G0 binding conditions and P0 tranche stop conditions.
Tests assert current runtime identity and v1 catalog files are not modified in the P0 diff.
Tests assert dope-memory V1=PROJECT_SCOPED, Serena V1=WORKTREE_SCOPED, P5 precedes P4, and ConPort target is gated.
validation: All cross-contract negative gates pass with zero authority-widening fixture accepted.

steps.task: Run the full P0 gate, freeze substantive bytes, obtain one independent L2 audit, record proof, and stop at operator merge decision.
requirements: Do not audit an intermediate content head.
A substantive repair creates a new content head and requires a new final audit.
A proof-only successor may preserve the audit only after deterministic ancestry and exact-path closure validation.
Do not mark ready, merge, activate, authorize Wave 2, or dispatch P1 without their separate gates.
validation: Focused and relevant complete suites pass or every nonzero result is explicitly classified and blocks readiness when required.
Final audit is bound to the frozen substantive content head.
PR Steward finality is run only after current exact-head proof is valid.
